title: chart-test-swarm scenario
description: One customer-shaped cluster + product chart + assertions. Path fields are resolved relative to the consumer project root (the dir containing chart-test-swarm.yaml).

not.description: capability and integration are mutually exclusive — a scenario must have one or neither, never both.

config.description: Path to provider-specific config (e.g. kind --config yaml). Relative to project root.

chart.description: Path or OCI ref (oci://...) to the chart. Local paths resolve against project root.

values.description: Path to values.yaml override. Relative to project root.

set.description: helm --set key=value overrides applied on top of values.

subcharts.description: Informational: which subchart variants are exercised. Surfaces in dashboard rollup.

category.description: Library taxonomy category (e.g. networking, gateway-api, service-mesh, certificates, storage, capability, cloud-native). Drives catalog grouping and support-matrix placement.

capability.description: Chart capability/compliance test name (e.g. label-all-objects, scheme-enforced). Mutually exclusive with 'integration' at the scenario level — one or the other (or neither).

integration.description: Integration target name (e.g. cert-manager, traefik, istio). Mutually exclusive with 'capability' at the scenario level — one or the other (or neither).

tier.description: Execution tier. live: runs on local kind. authored-only: cloud-specific, off by default. capability: addon-less render+deploy + manifest introspection.

mechanisms.description: Free-vocabulary rollup labels for the dashboard. Convention: <kind>:<name>, e.g. addon:istio, subchart:postgres-internal.

generated_by.description: Provenance: who/what generated this scenario. Optional but useful for dashboard filtering of LLM-generated scenarios.

integration.description: Integration target the scenario was generated for, e.g. 'cert-manager'

kind.description: Preinstall item kind. Defaults to 'helm' for backward compatibility with pre-F1.2 scenarios that omit this field.

oneOf.title: Helm chart preinstall
oneOf.description: Install a Helm chart before the product chart. This is the default kind when 'kind' is omitted.

chart.description: Helm chart ref. Either 'repo/name' (needs prior helm repo add) or OCI ref (oci://...).

values.description: Path to values.yaml or inline object. Path is relative to project root.

repo.description: If set, runs 'helm repo add <name> <url>' before install.

oneOf.title: Raw manifest preinstall
oneOf.description: Apply a raw Kubernetes manifest via kubectl apply -f before the product chart.

path.description: Path to the manifest file (relative to project root) or a URL (https://...). Required.

namespace.description: Optional namespace override passed via kubectl --namespace.

path.description: Path to executable. Receives RELEASE, NAMESPACE, KUBECONFIG as env.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: every rendered/live object carries the configured extra labels.

labels.description: Map of key=value labels expected on ALL objects (both .metadata.labels and pod template labels).

source.description: Where to inspect: helm template output, live kubectl output, or both.

kinds.description: Kubernetes kinds to check (default: all rendered/live kinds).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: every rendered/live object carries the configured extra annotations.

annotations.description: Map of key=value annotations expected on ALL objects (both .metadata.annotations and pod template annotations).

kinds.description: Kubernetes kinds to check (default: all rendered/live kinds).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: no plain-HTTP port/scheme when HTTPS-only is configured; Service/container ports reflect the configured scheme.

scheme.description: Expected scheme policy. https-only: no port 80 or http scheme on Service/container/probe/Ingress. allow-http: baseline check that http/80 is present.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: rbac.create=true yields expected ServiceAccount + Role/ClusterRole + RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding; false yields none.

expect_present.description: true: RBAC objects MUST exist and be wired. false: zero RBAC-kind objects.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: pod-level and container-level securityContext knobs are rendered with configured values (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: pod-level and container-level securityContext fields MUST appear with configured values. false: no securityContext block on any workload.

podSecurityContext.description: Expected pod-level securityContext fields (e.g. runAsNonRoot, seccompProfile.type). Checked when expect_present=true.

containerSecurityContext.description: Expected container-level securityContext fields (e.g. readOnlyRootFilesystem, allowPrivilegeEscalation, capabilities). Checked when expect_present=true.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: networkPolicy.enabled=true yields a NetworkPolicy selecting the product pods; false yields none.

expect_present.description: true: at least one NetworkPolicy MUST exist selecting the workload. false: zero NetworkPolicy documents.
